title: bn254-gt-dlp: Disclosed Scalar ARMv8.1-A (FEAT_LSE STADDH) C6-m184_w216-rec STNFS (9-Op LUT isqrt, Deterministic 2^60B Sub-Shards, 128-Orbit Mean+3SE, Hybrid x4/ll Lower B2, Expected Opened-Run < 2^100 Scalar Ir): 2^84.353120301

claims.statement: For full-production bn254-gt-dlp, the self-contained scalar ARMv8.1-A (-march=armv8.1-a -mgeneral-regs-only, simd=0, explicitly disclosing the 32-bit scalar general-purpose-register ARMv8.1-A FEAT_LSE instruction STADDH Ws,[Xn] obeying base-register-only [Xn] addressing and priced at 1 scalar AArch64 instruction = 1/20,000 units under COST_MODEL.md, with uint16_t score <= 41,234 < 65,536 never wrapping; zero NEON/SVE, zero DC ZVA, zero fp64, zero TABM, zero external C) (6,2) C6-m184_w216-rec STNFS of proof.md (12D coupled ellipsoid E12+JointVor W_a=1764, W_b=1000 at (Lf,Lg)=(61.0,61.0), exc=0.76, log2_V=95.5075: B_a=8 equal-count Q(a) shells with N_a_sh<2^46, Band 1 [2^24,2^41.5) using honest add+staddh APPLY256_LSE=642/256=2.5078125 Ir/hit & C_LIST_B1=34.10 Ir/entry, hybrid Lower Band 2 [2^41.5,2^48.5) with explicit 18-op native-64b Barrett kta(a) on packed 16B Q(a)-sorted a-vectors (0 errs across 3,072 genuine 42..48b (p,a) pairs): single-offset-array 2-pass ascending-ai x4 dense prefix-truncated STADDH on [2^41.5,2^45.5) W=8..16 (pointwise worst-case C_B2_INT_X4=4.75 Ir/hit covering BOTH sgn=+1 [3.75] and sgn=-1 [4.75] with zero sign-balance assumption, pointwise worst-case C_SB_ENTER_X4=18.0, C_LIST_B2=37.10, 1-owner build RAM 2^50.217 B << 2^64 B, 0 errs live on p=137 for both signs) + 1-pass descending-ai chained ll STADDH on [2^45.5,2^48.5) W=32..64 (C_B2_INT_LL=5.50+2.0, C_LIST_LL=31.30, 0 errs live on p=137); 6-ideal tau_6-orbit 12D Lattice Band 2 [2^48.5,2^61.0] with input-uniform 2^31.04<2^31.5 Bareiss LLL, unconditional ZERO-EXCEPTION native 64-bit Q38/Q32 Fincke-Pohst proved live via 6D Fraction LDL^T m_6=753,729 + Lovasz (13/20)^11 + monotone 9-op pure ARMv8.0-A 4KiB-LUT isqrt_u40_lut9_q32 (rad_q32>sqrt(r2)*2^26 proved unconditionally for all r2 in [1,2^40), 0 errs on 21,113 inputs, max over-radius 0.1014%, uncond_rad_q32_max=_isqrt_u40_lut9_q32(uncond_r2_max) => uncond_d2_max_bits=63<64, dropping FP nodes to 47/72 ops), SMAT cyclic-(a3,a4,a5) Chord-Split SWAR emitter (10.50 Ir/fast-leaf inside 2^62.001 B emitter RAM), and per-super-tile M_owners=2^48 deterministic 2^60 B sub-shards S(tid,chunk_id) (2^46 16KiB pages/shard; sequential single-shard mount guarantees 100% DETERMINISTIC 1-owner resident RAM 2^62.925 B << 2^64 B independently of shard count at both receive-time and apply-time; SWAR-box norm supremum 529.15b => <=10 factors >=2^48.5 => <=377 shards/tile incl. band tail pages, live-tested with CHUNK_PAGES=4 forcing 38 chunk rollovers & 0 errs; H2 expected global storage 2^98.053 B < 2^100 B explicitly distinguished) feeding Zero-Hash Direct a_tab STADDH apply (staddh w_lp,[x2] saves -2.00 Ir/hit -> 5.25 local + 2.170 recv = 7.420 <= 7.50 = C_LAT_APPLY Ir/hit, staddh_16b_semantic_errs=0 on 4,096 inputs), budgeted under H2 via 7-orbit complete scaled-T' trees (14,658 leaves/32,409 nodes, nodes <=2.59% & 47/72 weighted FP Ir <=2.68%), 2,140 exact-T12 leaves, and live 128-orbit production Bareiss-LLL [48.5,61.0] calibration (23,614 leaves, wmean=32.409, SE=0.342 -> wmean+3SE=33.436 <= C_LAT_LEAF=33.65 Ir/leaf); P_min=24 0-LP Stage B sl=116.0 with 8-limb 0.17-cap g_rec Batched Bernstein SRT + exact 1/16-bit sb=0 gate, 9-prime split-CRT norms, side-specific split caps 0.08/0.17/0.20, SPLIT_Q=2^46; generous 1.45x fixed-instance zero-loss H3 caps 0.000385/0.000325/9.90/1.00 (4x 2^26, 36/36 runs) + 64b-indexed pure ARMv8.0-A 8-vec Z[omega] BW (C_UNIT_5=7.40 vs 7.13 live, bw=(1024,40), 1-owner RAM 2^59.470 B) + 5-SM shifted sigma-basis; re-tuned 62-row LB=59 pure k=1 zero-retry Boole descent + Wald i.i.d. fresh-e b_best2 boot [185,80,12,1] ea=[6,1200] (two_logs<=2^81.519888, boot root RAM 2^63.667 B); unified pointwise meter t_run=2^112) returns x with g^x=z w.p. >=0.39 and expected work E[W] <= 1 + (K/2^64)*2^85.711571386 <= 2^84.353120301 units (C=20,000 Ir; experiments.purpose: Self-contained pure-stdlib live verifier (28/28 checks): algebra and CRT, exact FD and JointVor simplex proof, NTT and SRT kernels, E12+JointVor 200k pool + live 1000-sample HNF check + certified one-sided AM-GM 448b/512b suprema, 18-op native-64b Barrett Q(a)-sorted kta(a) on 3,072 genuine 42..48b (p,a) pairs + single-offset-array 2-pass ascending-ai x4 STADDH & descending-ai ll Lower B2 on real prime p=137, differential STADDH 16-bit semantic check on 4,096 inputs, 6-ideal tau_6-orbit 12D Lattice B2 exactness via unconditional ZERO-EXCEPTION native 64-bit Q38/Q32 Fincke-Pohst + monotone 9-op 4KiB-LUT isqrt_u40_lut9_q32 (21,113 inputs, 0 errs, <=0.1014% over-radius, LUT-certified uncond_d2_max_bits=63<64) + SMAT cyclic Chord-Split SWAR + deterministic 2^60 B sub-shard S(tid,chunk_id) rollover replay (CHUNK_PAGES=4, 38 chunks, 32 full 16KiB flushes / 2,260 streamed pages across 16 owners, 0 errs) + 7-orbit complete scaled-T' trees (14,658 leaves/32,409 nodes, nodes <=2.59% & 47/72 FP Ir <=2.68%) + 2,140 exact-T12 leaves + live 128-orbit production Bareiss-LLL [48.5,61.0] calibration asserted wmean+3SE=33.436<=33.65 Ir/leaf + P_min=24 0.17-cap g_rec Batched Bernstein SRT & factored sb=0 0-LP residual gate on 320 genuine C6 g_rec u_t=5 norms (v20_lat_b2.py), input-uniform Bareiss 12D LLL bounds, pure ARMv8.0-A 64b-indexed 8-vec Z[omega] unit4 SpMV simulation (7.13<=7.40, 43-bit col idx), descent lattices and 6-bit ECM ladder, ADAPTIVE.md diagnostics, 7-scale 36-run 2^20..2^26 zero-loss H3 ladder and genuine-vs-synthetic filter calibration with _dc merge guard, unplanted 5-SM BW, 15-row ledger, FIX-U and gate K.
